name: SeoulMidcity
title: Seoul Midcity
description: Street-level perspective down a dense pedestrian boulevard framed by stacked apartments, noodle kiosks, glass retail units, overhead walkways, and a curving automated tram viaduct; readable Korean holographic signage and practical service conduits.
palette: Rainy blue-hour, wet pavement reflections, cyan/rose/amber neon; bustling but believable lived-in future.

name: CelestialSpearGuildHall
title: Celestial Spear Guild Hall
description: Double-height prestigious lobby in black basalt, brushed steel, and electric-blue glass; stylized spear insignia, reception station, display cases for retired raid equipment, training wing behind glass, floating mission boards.
palette: Clean cool daylight with cobalt edge lighting and discreet warm hospitality lights.

name: GateResearchFacility
title: Gate Research Facility
description: Shielded observation chamber looking through layered blast-resistant windows into a circular, restrained dimensional aperture; scanning gantries, modular computers, sensor rails, emergency shutters, warning stripes.
palette: Sterile white/cold cyan light, restrained violet Gate glow, convincing industrial safety design.

name: LowerCityMarket
title: Lower City Market
description: Narrow covered alley with weathered concrete, improvised shop counters, prosthetic repair signs, steaming food carts, overhead electrical cabling and stacked housing; legal stalls intermixed with ambiguous brokers.
palette: Night, saturated magenta/red signage, amber shop lamps, pooled rainwater and mist.

name: CorporateTower
title: Corporate Tower
description: Expansive upper-floor boardroom with long modular dark-glass table, privacy glass, a city-wide panoramic window, restrained holographic financial interfaces, architectural security doors.
palette: Midnight blue skyline, soft gold accent lights, polished black/graphite surfaces.

name: ThornwildForest
title: Thornwild Forest
description: Immense root-buttressed trees, oversized fern canopy, mossed stone steps from a forgotten path, luminous vines and crystal-lichen on fallen logs; several layers of canopy receding toward a barely seen ruin.
palette: Emerald/teal green and cool turquoise bioluminescence; morning fog and drifting spores.

name: MiregraveSwamp
title: Miregrave Swamp
description: Black shallow water, collapsed timber causeway, twisted leafless cypress trunks, giant bracket fungi, bubbles in stagnant pools, hanging moss and spore towers.
palette: Sickly olive, acid chartreuse, muted brown, ominous low green fog.

name: StormpeakHighlands
title: Stormpeak Highlands
description: Knife-edged basalt cliffs, narrow stone ledges, shattered alpine pillars, distant peak archipelago and wind-raked scrub; a circling weather front above a ravine.
palette: Steel gray, indigo, electric-white lightning; dramatic overcast daylight.

name: AzureCrystalCavern
title: Azure Crystal Cavern
description: Colossal cavern with ribbed limestone, clusters of towering faceted blue-violet crystals, broken mining terraces, reflective black pool, branching tunnels and suspended crystal shards.
palette: Azure, amethyst, soft white internal crystal light, deep dark recesses.

name: FrostveilTundra
title: Frostveil Tundra
description: Expansive wind-scoured blue ice plain, jagged frozen shelves, buried stone structures, distant glacier wall and sparse frost-coated shrubs; swirling snow corridors.
palette: Pale ice blue, pearl white, subdued lavender shadows, dim arctic sky.

name: AshenCrucible
title: Ashen Crucible
description: Terraced obsidian plateau split by thick lava rivers, basalt bridge, fumaroles, ash-coated spires, distant crater wall and heat-shimmering rocky badlands.
palette: Coal black, molten orange, crimson reflections, smoldering red haze.

name: SunkenTempleRuins
title: Sunken Temple Ruins
description: Partially flooded pillared sanctuary, collapsed vaulted roof, engraved stone floor beneath shallow dark water, mossy statues, mysterious sealed door at the far end.
palette: Muted jade, weathered sandstone, watery cyan reflections and shafts of filtered daylight.

name: BlackglassAnomaly
title: Blackglass Anomaly
description: Vast plain of glossy fractured black glass plates floating at uneven angles, disconnected doorframes, suspended shards, duplicated horizon lines and distant spatial seams.
palette: Violet-black, oil-slick indigo, white cracks and sparse magenta distortions.

name: EternalArchive
title: Eternal Archive
description: Impossible multi-tiered library carved in pale stone, suspended circular book galleries, ancient automated catalog rails, floating rune tablets and one towering sealed central vault.
palette: Ivory, warm brass, cobalt arcane glyphs; dramatic volumetric library light.

name: FallenMetropolis
title: Fallen Metropolis
description: Silent boulevard between collapsed high-rise carcasses of unknown architecture, overgrown elevated transit, cracked pavement, sand-drifted vehicles of unfamiliar manufacture, rusted signal towers.
palette: Muted concrete gray and oxidized copper, moss green, overcast dusty light.

name: HollowNecropolis
title: Hollow Necropolis
description: Black-stone mausoleum complex, terraced tombs, skeletal trees, cracked monuments, sinking crypt stairways, distant bell tower under looming arches.
palette: Moon-silver, charcoal, cold cyan spirit lights and thin lavender haze.

name: AbyssalReef
title: Abyssal Reef
description: Deep submerged coral valley with colossal shell-like formations, coral arches, luminous anemones, silt floor, ancient tiled fragments and steep trench descending to darkness.
palette: Bioluminescent cyan, sea green, ultramarine and purple; filtered shafts from distant surface.

name: SunscarDesert
title: Sunscar Desert
description: Sun-baked ochre dunes and wind-shaped sandstone fins, half-buried stairway, crumbled astronomical observatory, rippling heat haze and old caravan markers.
palette: Copper gold, pale ochre, turquoise shadow, bright white midday sun.

name: CelestialExpanse
title: Celestial Expanse
description: Layered floating islands connected by broken causeways, hanging waterfalls vanishing into cloud oceans, wind-bent grass, ruined circular observatory and distant towering sky spires.
palette: Sky blue, pearly white, muted gold and luminous cloud violet at sunrise.

name: IronheartDepths
title: Ironheart Depths
description: Massive subterranean forge city of unknown origin with chain-supported gantries, huge inactive smelting furnaces, metal bridges over dim geothermal channels, slag heaps and gearlike stone machinery.
palette: Burnished copper, ember red, iron gray, occasional cyan runic indicator light.
